title: Dragon (European and Chinese traditions)
description: Folklore record: the great serpent of world mythology — fire-breathing hoard-guardian in Europe, celestial bringer of rain in China.

title: Phoenix
description: Folklore record: the fire-bird that burns and is reborn — Egyptian bennu, Greek phoenix, Chinese fenghuang.

title: Unicorn
description: Folklore record: the single-horned horse of medieval bestiaries — purity, healing, and the alicorn trade.

title: Griffin
description: Folklore record: eagle's head and wings on a lion's body — guardian of gold in Scythian tales.

title: Chimera
description: Folklore record: the Lycian monster of lion, goat, and serpent — slain by Bellerophon in Greek myth.

title: Basilisk
description: Folklore record: the king of serpents, whose gaze kills — from Pliny's natural history to medieval bestiaries.

title: Kitsune
description: Folklore record: the Japanese fox spirit — shapeshifter, trickster, and messenger of Inari, growing tails with age.

title: Thunderbird
description: Folklore record: the great bird of Indigenous North American traditions, whose wings make thunder.
